# platform

The actions your AI can run on platform through DozalDevs. They are the same tools a Dozal uses, run the same way. Run one with `run_app_action` (MCP) or the run-app-action command, app `platform` and the action's slug below; `get_app_action` shows its inputs. A Viewer key runs only the actions that read.

| Action      | Reads or changes | What it does                                                           |
| ----------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CALCULATE` | reads            | Safely evaluate an arithmetic expression and return the numeric result |
